purpose: Known-true AI systems at >=500 stars, collected INDEPENDENTLY of the classifier by a live-web agent seeded with ~725 candidates across paper drops, Chinese labs, bio/speech/robotics/inference/RL and thin-metadata repositories, then verified one by one against the GitHub API. It exists so recall is a measured number at every predicate version instead of an assertion, and so a later version cannot quietly trade recall away.
discipline: This fixture may FALSIFY a rule - a known-true system failing reveals an over-broad filter - but may NEVER supply tokens to match its own rows. Recall figures are published with their precision denominator; a recall number alone is not evidence of anything.
known_impurity: Seeded by an agent, so it contains a few non-systems: grpc/grpc and NVIDIA/open-gpu-kernel-modules were classed as AI systems by the collector and are not. Recall measured on it is therefore a slight UNDER-estimate of true recall, which is the safe direction for a fixture.
